slides.title: Introduction
slides.body:
CSS Box model
Every HTML element on a  web page is a rectangular box
slides.notes:
The CSS Box Model is like a way of imagining every element on a webpage as a box.

Every Element in HTML is a rectangular box but instead of calling them boxes we call them HTML Elements
Any website you look at is nothing but rectangular boxes arranged next to, on top of, below and nested within each other.

By default very html will take a box shape

slides.title: Backgrounds
slides.body: Devices with Various Screen Dimensions
slides.notes: Every device will be of different dimensions (width, height) etc. So it’s not possible for us to define height to see our image full screen in all the devices. So, we can use viewport height (100vh)The browser's viewport is the area of the window in which web content can be seen.

slides.title: Backgrounds
slides.body:
Viewport
The browser's viewport is the area of the window in which web content can be seen.
slides.notes: Every device will be of different dimensions (width, height) etc. So it’s not possible for us to define height to see our image full screen in all the devices. So, we can use viewport height (100vh)The browser's viewport is the area of the window in which web content can be seen.

slides.title: Backgrounds
slides.body:
Viewport Height
Viewport Height is based on the height of the user's visible area of a web page (viewport).
slides.notes: Every device will be of different dimensions (width, height) etc. So it’s not possible for us to define height to see our image full screen in all the devices. So, we can use viewport height (100vh)The browser's viewport is the area of the window in which web content can be seen.

slides.title: Backgrounds
slides.body:
Viewport Height (vh)
100vh = 100% of the viewport height
50vh = 50% of the viewport height

This is one of the approach

We can add Background Image by using background-image property. 
For adding a Background Image we need to specify the image url.
While providing value to the background-image property we place url word and next to that we place image url enclosed with in brackets.

It makes the background image big enough to fully cover the element (like a div or the whole page).
The image will scale up or down so that no empty space is left.
Some parts of the image may get cropped (cut off) if the proportions don’t match the element.
